info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Larnite Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Larnite Pendant Detail Submission API allows businesses to submit detailed information about Larnite pendants to the catalog. This API facilitates the integration of product details, ensuring that all relevant specifications and attributes are recorded accurately. Typical users include product managers and e-commerce teams who are responsible for updating and maintaining the product catalog. By utilizing this endpoint, companies can enhance their inventory with rich, detailed product information, driving better customer engagement and sales.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create detailed information for a Larnite Pendant. It accepts the necessary parameters in the request body to set up the details effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update the details of a Larnite pendant. It requires specific attributes related to the pendant details to be provided in JSON format.

CreateCatalogLarnitePendantDetailRequest.title: Larnite Pendant Details Request

larnite_pendant_id.description: The unique identifier for the Larnite pendant.

requestedBy.description: The name of the individual or entity requesting the pendant.

quantity.description: The quantity of Larnite pendants being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority order.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Larnite pendant.

CreateCatalogLarnitePendantDetailRequest.description: Schema for the request body when creating or updating Larnite pendant details.
